threat_model.attacker_knowledge: knows truth and all honest report values within each task
threat_model.identity_model: fixed reporter identities within each task; no churn
threat_model.root_authenticity: root labels assumed accurate; root compromise is excluded

limitations: Synthetic binary tasks and source reliability rates do not estimate field behavior.
Attackers are given ground truth and are stronger than typical uninformed agents.
Faults are reporter identities; forged or compromised provenance roots are excluded.
The experiment evaluates aggregation only and provides no authorization guarantee.
